title: Review catch system exception
why: Catching System.Exception without a specific type boundary can intercept failures the handler cannot recover from.
suggestion: Catch the specific exception types you can handle, use an explicit positive type filter, or propagate failures to the appropriate boundary.
limitations: Explicit positive type filters on the caught binding using C# or patterns or || are excluded, including multiline headers.
Negative filters, mixed predicates, helper calls, aliases and type hierarchies are not resolved; unknown filters remain reportable.
